purpose: User-directed calibration so one parameter vector more closely reproduces tightened Q2 and T1 measurements, including tracking and sync RMS. In-sample descriptive fit, not an independent test or controller comparison.
initialization: Round78 shared vector fitted only on the same two tightened records from its declared fresh seed; no loose-Q2 fitted vector initialization.
objective: For each full record: half-weight normalized elapsed-time-average squared mean-position and full sync waveform errors, plus tracking/sync task RMS relative discrepancies scaled by 0.10; regularization 1e-8. Task statistics use continuous predicted positions for optimization, original encoder mapping for final reporting. 0.10 is an optimization scale, not a physical validation threshold.
scope: Existing nine-parameter model; original input and dt, zero state only once per record, no measured future state injection, no synthetic disturbance or output correction, no subset removal other than documented previous-session prefix. Hold inputs still 40-step averages. Forced-input simulation, not autonomous closed-loop replication.
